description: This file declares utility functions related to inotify file descriptor monitoring, specifically for retrieving lists of created files and files matching certain masks within the 'cuttlefish' namespace.

methods.name: GetCreatedFileListFromInotifyFd
methods.description: Retrieves a list of file paths that have been created or modified according to the inotify file descriptor.

methods.name: GetFileListFromInotifyFd
methods.description: Retrieves a list of file paths matching a specific mask from the inotify file descriptor.
